lead.hed: Defense News: the Army is ending a Europe drone battalion. An experiment is not a TO&E.
lead.insight: Defense News, Friday 08:14: an Army official said Thursday the experimental drone battalion in Europe ends after Exercise Saber Junction in August and September, then returns to its airborne infantry mission. The statement did not name the unit or give a headcount. Gen. Christopher LaNeve’s “Army Azimuth” still talks stand-off weapons and soldier fundamentals. A background line is not a published order. An experiment ending is not a drone freeze.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Army Reserve photo by Capt. Katherine Bustos · DVIDS 9696956 · PUBLIC DOMAIN · Staff Sgt. Nicholas Davis and Spc. Octavio Landeros, Field Artillery Squadron, 2d Cavalry Regiment, secure wings on a one-way attack Hornet drone, Bemowo Piskie Training Area, Poland, May 3, 2026
lead.image_note: Official U.S. Army DVIDS still of a one-way attack Hornet drone in Europe. Same-subject class as Friday's Europe drone-battalion story — not a photo of the unnamed airborne unit, not Saber Junction 2026, not a brand tile. Caption must say 2CR / Poland / May 3.

political.hed: Heritage: fewer Taiwan Strait transits. A quieter strait is not a quieter PLA.
political.insight: Heritage, Thursday: after December 2025 Chinese exercises around Taiwan featured a mock air-and-naval blockade, a pair of U.S. ships made the first 2026 Strait transit weeks later. The question is whether fewer sails change the blockade math. A commentary is not a transit log. Presence is not a treaty.

political.hed: Heritage: an H-2A bill is not a harvest. Amnesty language is not a visa tweak.
political.insight: Heritage, Thursday: the House Agriculture chairman’s Securing Agriculture’s Workforce Act of 2026 would broaden work visas and, Heritage says, amount to amnesty for illegal aliens plus a permanent foreign-labor pipeline. A committee bill is not law. A guest-worker expansion is not a seasonal patch.

political.hed: WORLD: a Calvin professor wants “unknowing.” Mystery is not a substitute for the Word.
political.insight: WORLD, Thursday: James K.A. Smith’s new Yale book urges mystical non-knowing after a midlife crisis. The review says that path drops revelation, the Mediator, and doctrinal discernment — union with an unknown Absolute is not orthodox Christianity. A book is not a council. Humility about self is not doubt about the gospel.

tech.hed: Defense News: Navy posted a next-gen SeaSparrow ask. A Sources Sought is not a missile.
tech.insight: Defense News, Thursday: the Navy is leading a 12-nation NATO SeaSparrow Project Office hunt for an NSV variant — sea-skimmer to high-diver, massed salvos, jamming. Deadline Oct. 19. Ten-inch max, Mark 41 fit, data rights to the consortium. A notice is not a buy. Paper is not a round in the cell.

tech.hed: USNI: Northern Viking is underway in Iceland. An exercise is not a GIUK garrison.
tech.insight: USNI, Thursday: the U.S., Iceland, and NATO began biennial Northern Viking 2026 on Tuesday; it runs in Iceland and surrounding waters through Sept. 3. Seventy-fifth year of the 1951 U.S.–Iceland defense agreement. DVIDS: opening ceremony at Keflavik Aug. 18. A kickoff is not a permanent base. Training is not a campaign.

tech.hed: Defense News: a C-17 to Antarctica turned back. A NOTAM is not a shoot-down.
tech.insight: Defense News, Thursday: a U.S. Air Force C-17A (call sign ICE28) left Christchurch Tuesday, then returned after New Zealand issued a NOTAM on Russian notice of a planned missile launch and hazard in the Oceanic FIR. PACAF called it a routine Antarctic resupply window. A turnaround is not an intercept. A danger area is not a closed sky.

watch.hed: WATCH: Ulchi Freedom Shield ends today. A shorter drill is not a new treaty.
watch.insight: Defense News Wednesday file, still the clock Friday: allies cut Ulchi Freedom Shield from 11 days to five — ends Friday, Aug. 21, not Aug. 27. Some live events cancelled or moved to simulations. Kim Yo Jong still called it provocative. A shorter calendar is not a treaty rewrite.

watch.hed: WATCH: George Washington is in CENTCOM. A hull in the AOR is not a campaign.
watch.insight: USNI Thursday file: USS George Washington (CVN-73) arrived in the CENTCOM area Wednesday with cruiser USS Robert Smalls and destroyer USS Shoup. Presence is not a strike order. Thursday PM lead, still the file Friday morning.

watch.hed: WATCH: Navy charged a Kennedy sailor in a shipmate’s death. A charge is not a verdict.
watch.insight: USNI, Wednesday: the Navy charged Aviation Boatswain’s Mate Airman Apprentice Jayjrion Rodriguez with murder, involuntary manslaughter, and assault in the death of a boatswain’s mate aboard John F. Kennedy (CVN-79). A charge sheet is not a court-martial finding.
